benchmark: Holochain Runtime Capability Matrix for Mycelix SAP V2

documentation_evidence.claim: The workspace version table documents conductor 0.6.1.

conductor.interpretation: The documentation states 0.6.1, but the committed Finance flake.lock resolves the nested Holonix Holochain source input from ref holochain-0.6.0. The actual packaged conductor --version output has not been captured. Do not label the built runtime 0.6.1 or 0.6.0 until it is executed from the locked flake.

evidence.claim: Finance workspace dependency pins for HDK, HDI and Holochain type crates.

countersigning.note: The exact conductor source is not yet established from the runtime output; the DNA manifest contains no explicit countersigning/witness enablement modifier. The official documentation describes countersigning as unstable and disabled by default in Holochain 0.4+. Treat exact Mycelix enablement as unknown.

dna_manifest.statement: No countersigning or witness enablement field was found in the audited DNA integrity properties. This does not prove conductor-level countersigning cannot be enabled.

fork_warrants.claim: The current agent-status guide distinguishes general invalid-operation warrants from chain-fork warrants: general validation warrants are produced, while chain-fork warrants are not yet operational. get_agent_activity can report observed chain-fork state, but lack of discovered evidence is not proof of no fork.

agent_activity.claim: get_agent_activity Status/Full can report the queried authority's current view of chain status, discovered forks and warrants. The view is eventually consistent; absence of a fork/warrant means only that the queried authority has not discovered evidence yet.

claims: Countersigning is documented as unstable and disabled by default in Holochain 0.4 and newer.
All participants must be online simultaneously for the countersigning session.
Countersigning coordinates a shared write but is not itself a general double-spend prevention mechanism.

local_zome_call_atomicity.claim: Writes in one zome function call are transactional and commit or fail together; competing source-chain activity may cause a chain-head-moved rollback.
local_zome_call_atomicity.qualification_required: The Mycelix Payments pool/member write path still requires exact-head Sweettest and failure-injection proof.

compatibility.migration_policy: Do not upgrade solely to obtain a desired feature; compare matching HDK/HDI, conductor, DNA/WASM, client API, migration and operational behavior first.

general_invalid_operation_warrants.claim: The 0.5-to-0.6 upgrade guide says warrants became stable in Holochain 0.6 and get_agent_activity returns a list of warrants.

normative_interpretation.GoodSoFar: No conflict has yet been observed by the queried authority set. It is not finality and may be superseded by later evidence.
normative_interpretation.NotAvailable: The required primitive or authority query cannot be used in the exact runtime.
normative_interpretation.Indeterminate: The evidence set, DHT view, signer set or authority status is incomplete or timed out.
normative_interpretation.Conflict: Contradictory owner/witness/economic observations exist; affected outputs are frozen.
normative_interpretation.Provisional: An exact action/claim exists but the assurance threshold for spendability has not been established.
normative_interpretation.SpendableWitnessed: Forbidden until the exact runtime capability, trusted policy, authenticated session facts, quorum and local witness-allocation rules are proven and qualified.

required_runtime_tests: Capture actual conductor --version and binary digest from the build artifact.
Capture exact Holonix/Nix lock and conductor configuration digests.
Record DNA integrity/coordinator WASM and DNA pack digests.
Prove whether countersigning APIs compile against exact HDK 0.6.1 and whether conductor config enables them.
Run multi-agent countersigning preflight, mandatory signer, optional signer strict-majority, timeout, offline participant, abort and duplicate-session tests if available.
Run delayed fork/authority-observation tests; verify GoodSoFar can later become Conflict/BadActor and never becomes final by absence.
Prove source-chain head movement rolls back local multi-entry writes and that retry reconciliation retains original operation identity.
Repeat the same fixture against matched 0.6.1, 0.6.3 and 0.7.1 stacks before any runtime migration decision.
qualification_claim: This artifact records repository pins and official documentation statements. General warrants are documented stable in Holochain 0.6, but chain-fork warrants are separately documented as not operational. The public source docs claim conductor 0.6.1, while Finance flake.lock resolves a nested Holochain source ref holochain-0.6.0; actual binary --version is not captured. It contains no runtime binary digest, no enabled-countersigning proof, no live fork-warrant test, and no conductor integration result. It is not runtime qualification.
